summary: The independently defined extended log-contribution-minus-reference-KL objective has the literal reference-times-contribution normalized optimizer. Zero support gives genuine bottom values. Uniqueness at positive total is proved over the full finite simplex.
source: arxive/playingTheNetworkBackward/main.tex:2505–2563 local Value-routing objective and active-player policy/value proposition

model_correspondence.evidence: The objective explicitly evaluates sum(p*log contribution)-ReferencePolicy.kl(p,reference), with independent support guards on reference and contribution. The equivalence to mass entropy is proved by weighted log-product algebra, handling zero policy terms before expanding logarithms. Unsupported policies have WithBot bottom, not real log-zero values.

A strict coordinate entropy inequality covers zero policy probabilities and zero mass coordinates. Any difference from normalized mass yields a strict global gap. Unsupported policies cannot attain the finite maximum. No global positive-support assumption is introduced.

valuePolicy constructs a normalized Policy from actual product masses and positive total. IsGreatest includes attainment and a bound over every policy. The policy formula is literally reference_i*contribution_i divided by the total. Positive total rules out an empty action space without assuming an optimizer.

Nonnegative factors and zero total force all product masses to zero. Every normalized policy has a positive coordinate and therefore bottom objective. No unique zero-stream optimizer or normalized zero ratio is claimed.

boundary_cases: positive policy on zero reference is bottom
zero-policy impossible action does not spoil supported pure optimum
boundary optimizer assigns zero to unsupported action
literal nondegenerate optimizer ratio one seventh
empty action type admits no Policy

negative_controls: treating log zero as finite real zero
claiming a unique policy when every stream mass vanishes
independent_experiment.scope: Exact support and optimizer ratios with numerical high-precision logarithmic comparisons supplement universal Lean proofs. Only local active-player value optimization is tested.

scope_limits: This is the active-player local Value-routing variational problem. It does not define or prove the inactive-player bottom convention, full attention SPNE, or attention occupation/relevance identities.
The zero-total theorem gives all-policy bottom value; it does not construct a cemetery absorption policy or assert uniqueness there.

Reference normalization is unnecessary for the algebraic generalization; the source specializes it to a row-stochastic attention reference. Actual QK/softmax construction and shared reference across feature dimensions remain separate.
